verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents bank and credit card reconciliation that checks every transaction against the bank statement (puzzle-docs-29). AI Close also uses AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies (puzzle-docs-24, puzzle-docs-39). The evidence does not describe separate matched, unmatched or duplicate review lists, so the review part of the story is only implied by 'surface discrepancies'. Missing for 10: explicit matched/unmatched transaction views, duplicate-transaction detection, per-account reconciliation workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
